Subject: BlueTel payment credentials & PO reference

Hi Elena,

Thanks for engaging with Redwood — excited to get BlueTel set up so we can process the initial PO and ongoing invoices quickly. To complete vendor onboarding our finance team needs the following items:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (signed)
- W-9 (or local tax form)
- Voided check or bank letter for ACH verification
- Preferred remit format (ACH vs wire) and any invoice-to-PO mapping rules

Can you attach those documents here? We have PO PO-6721 ready to be routed to your account once credentials are verified. Please note: Redwood requires the remittance reference string to include the PO number + our vendor remit token (example: PO-6721 | REMIT_CODE). Finance will confirm micro-deposit details after they receive the voided check/bank letter.

If you prefer, you can upload documents to this shared folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cBluetelOnboard

Next steps I will take after we get the docs: loop in Jonas (finance) to run micro-deposit, confirm PO mapping, and finalize payment channel.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0198

Routing (ACH): 011000138

Let us know once finance initiates the micro-deposit and we will confirm immediately.

Thanks Elena — received the docs and the voided check looks good. Marissa / Karthik — next steps from Finance:

1) We'll initiate two micro-deposits (random amounts < $1) into the account Elena provided to validate ACH. Expect them in 1-2 business days. Please have BlueTel confirm the amounts once received.
2) Once confirmed we will enable ACH payouts for PO-6721 and add remittance mapping. Our system will require the remittance string to match exactly: "PO-6721 | BT-042" so please ensure your invoice generation includes that.
3) For wires (backup) we will store the wire routing/SWIFT as provided; wires will require additional copy of bank letter for first-time wire setup — we have the voided check but will request bank letter if/when wires are used.

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx to track items and will update when micro-deposits post.

Jonas Weber
Director, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
(650) 555-2222

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx
